messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 streaming tail latency spike detected for /v1/decode (us-west1). p99 jumped from ~1.1s to ~6.8s over last 3m. Error rate stable. Affected: 12% of streaming sessions. SLO breach (p99>5s).
maya (oncall): I'm on it. grabbing metrics + recent deploys.
jana (runtime): saw a correlating kernel rollout at 6791232000 (kernel-rt v2.4.1 -> v2.4.2) and TRT8 flashattn bump earlier. could be related.
liam (eng-sre): checking infra (OOMs, node restarts, page faults). starting `htop` and `dmesg` on a sample host.
ops-bot: Deploy event: user=noah action=rollout component=runtime-kernel version=v2.4.2 started at 6791231950.
noah (build): I pushed a kernel packaging change (compileflag LTO on) this morning to address decode throughput. didn't see regressions in perf tests but tests were non-streaming.
maya (oncall): quick customer impact note: CS says a few integrations reported timeouts. Tanvi, any direct tickets?
tanvi (customer-success): We have 3 in-prod customers pinging, one provider on higher tier seeing increased retries. Escalated to SEs.
jana (runtime): grabbing flame graphs and tail traces. streaming paths show KV cache miss spikes and long decode tail when seq_len>1024. stackpoints show kernel scheduling latency, not pure GPU saturation.
liam (eng-sre): nodes show a small uptick in soft page faults and `task->sched_latency` in kernel logs. nothing OOM. attaching snippet.
--- log snippet ---
[6791234001] decode-worker[2234]: sched_delay=12ms pages_faulted=3 seq_id=abc123
[6791234002] decode-worker[2234]: kv_cache_miss=1 tail_latency=5400ms
--- end snippet ---
noah (build): hmm LTO and some new inline changes could affect instruction cache behavior leading to longer kernel preemption.
jana (runtime): can we rollback kernel on a small canary pool? prefer circling back with a mitigation first: route traffic for streaming to older kernel pool and fall back to cpu-bound decode variant for long sequences.
maya (oncall): good plan. Liam can you spin up a routing rule to bias traffic away from nodes running v2.4.2? If we can do a quick canary rollback that'd be ideal.
liam (eng-sre): creating reroute policy now. `infractl route add --name p99-mit --match route=/v1/decode --avoid-kernel v2.4.2 --duration 30m`
ops-bot: Route change applied: p99-mit avoiding nodes with kernel v2.4.2. Rolling updates in progress.
jana (runtime): starting an ephemeral pool with kernel v2.4.1 and enabling model-variant fallback for long sequences (`model:decode-light` for seq>1024).
dev-deploy-bot: Canary rollback initiated for 25% of decode-serving fleet to kernel v2.4.1 at 6791234200.
maya (oncall): monitoring p95/p99 now. please post p95/p99 every 1m.
liam (eng-sre): p95: 820ms -> 600ms, p99: 6.8s -> 2.0s after initial reroute (t+2m). improvement but still above SLO.
jana (runtime): after canary at 25% now p99 down to 1.3s across canary cohort, but remaining cohort still at ~3.8s. kernel path strongly correlated.
noah (build): I'm preparing a hotfix build disabling LTO + reverting the inline patch, will push to v2.4.3 candidate.
tanvi (customer-success): passing update to affected customers. asking for ETA on full mitigation.
maya (oncall): ETA for full rollback?
liam (eng-sre): if we push full fleet rollback to v2.4.1 it will take ~12m to roll. we can accelerate but risk transient errors. recommendation: full rollback.
jana (runtime): agree. also will add extra tracing around flashattn kernel entries to ensure not hitting bad scheduling paths.
maya (oncall): please proceed with full rollback. escalate to execs if longer than 30m.
dev-deploy-bot: Rollback in progress: 100% target fleet to v2.4.1 starting at 6791234260; expected completion ~6791234980.
liam (eng-sre): p99 60s after rollback start: 1.1s, p95 420ms. SLOs back within range for most routes. continuing to monitor.
jana (runtime): still seeing a handful of streaming stalls in older traces — digging for root cause: compiler flags + TRT8 flashattn combination may create worst-case scheduling windows for long sequences.
noah (build): will keep v2.4.1 in stable channel until we validate the no-LTO candidate. generating perf tests that include streaming long sequences.
maya (oncall): customer update: pushing a brief note to affected customers summarizing rollback and ETA for postmortem. Tanvi to follow up with more detailed RCA later.
tanvi (customer-success): will send update and open a bridged postmortem thread with affected accounts.
liam (eng-sre): opening incident ticket INC-6791. tagging SEs and accounts.
jana (runtime): next steps: run detailed perf sweep with TRT8+flashattn+LTO off, instrument kernel preemption counters, add guardrail to routing to avoid kernel-variant mixing during rollouts.
maya (oncall): handoff: I'll be on-call for another 45m, then handing to @liam. leaving notes in pager and marking incident as active->mitigated.
liam (eng-sre): taking handoff at 6791234700. will own follow-ups and postmortem.
incident-bot: Incident INC-6791 created: priority=sev2 impacted_routes=/v1/decode mitigated_by=kernel-rollback start=6791234567 mitigation=rollback to v2.4.1 assigned=liam
maya (oncall): thanks team. if anything regresses ping pager immediately. :thumbsup:
noah (build): I'll run the expanded perf matrix and ping here with artifacts and flamegraphs.
jana (runtime): collecting traces now and will attach in postmortem.
tanvi (customer-success): will coordinate customer comms and follow up with timeline.
--- thread end ---
